Class StartupConfigLoader

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.StartupConfigLoader
public final class StartupConfigLoader extends Object
Resolves and loads a ChaosPlan during JVM agent startup.

Configuration sources are checked in priority order (first match wins):

  1. Inline JSON — agent arg configJson or env MACSTAB_CHAOS_CONFIG_JSON
  2. Base64-encoded JSON — agent arg configBase64 or env MACSTAB_CHAOS_CONFIG_BASE64
  3. File path — agent arg configFile or env MACSTAB_CHAOS_CONFIG_FILE

Within each source type, the agent arg takes precedence over the system property ( macstab.chaos.configJson, macstab.chaos.configBase64, macstab.chaos.configFile), which takes precedence over the environment variable.

If no source is configured, load(String, Map) returns empty — the agent starts with no active scenarios.

    • loadPlanFromFile

      public static ChaosPlan loadPlanFromFile(String filePath)
      Reads and parses a chaos plan file with the same hardening applied to the JVM-agent config path: normalised resolution, symlink rejection, 1 MiB size cap, and NOFOLLOW_LINKS read to close the TOCTOU window between validation and open.

      Intended for framework integrations (Spring starter, Quarkus extension) that accept an operator-supplied plan path and must not bypass the agent's file-read hardening.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the file path to read
      Returns:
      the parsed chaos plan
      Throws:
      ConfigLoadException - if the path is unsafe, unreadable, oversize, or the JSON is invalid

    • readPlanFile

      @Internal public static Optional<StartupConfigLoader.PlanFile> readPlanFile(String filePath)
      Reads a plan file with the startup checks (regular file or Kubernetes ConfigMap link, size cap, permissions), for a poller that reloads it.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the configured path
      Returns:
      the file and its contents, or empty when the configured path does not exist
      Throws:
      ConfigLoadException - if the path is unsafe or unreadable

    • statPlanFile

      @Internal public static Optional<StartupConfigLoader.PlanFileStamp> statPlanFile(String filePath)
      Reads the stamp of a plan file, following the Kubernetes ConfigMap link as readPlanFile(String) does, without opening the file or applying its trust checks (they apply when the file is read).
      Parameters:
      filePath - the configured path
      Returns:
      the stamp, or empty when the path, or the directory a ConfigMap link points at, does not exist
      Throws:
      ConfigLoadException - if a link is not the ConfigMap layout or the attributes cannot be read
